thread:
tom_customer: Hey team — our rerank/batch endpoint is returning misaligned scores after we started sending CSVs with a header row. Each result looks shifted by one candidate. This started after we added a header for our analytics. App: AcmeSearch. Severity: high.

elaine_support: thanks @tom_customer — can you paste an anonymized sample of the CSV (first 5 rows) and the exact request headers you used? Also which client (curl/python/sdk)?

tom_customer: sample below (anonymized):
```csv
candidate_id,title,body
c123,Blue widget,Description A
c124,Green widget,Description B
c125,Red widget,Description C
```
We POSTed to POST /v1/rerank/batch with `Content-Type: text/csv` and body = file. No special query params. Got HTTP 200 but scores don't line up with rows.

elaine_support: copying in eng: @raj_engineer

raj_engineer: looking. quick question — do you upload as multipart/form-data or raw text/csv? and are you sending any header like `X-Rerank-Format: csv`? Also curious if the client added an extra blank line.

tom_customer: raw text/csv, no extra headers. confirmed no blank lines.

maya_ml: I can repro locally with that exact CSV. Observed parser treats the header row as a candidate when header is present but no explicit header flag is passed. Repro steps I ran:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank/batch"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: text/csv"
  --data-binary @sample.csv
```
Server responds 200 and returns N scores for N+1 candidates in our internal parse; then we drop the last score which causes a shift. Log snippet: `ParsedCandidates=4, Scores=3 -> candidate_index_mismatch`

raj_engineer: thanks @maya_ml. initial triage: our CSV ingestion pipeline currently defaults to "no header" mode unless `header=true` param is set. But we also have an autocast that tried to coerce first row into candidate when certain token patterns are seen — that autocast is over-eager when header-like columns (e.g., candidate_id,title) are present. That's why header rows end up as data.

maya_ml: minimal repro attached in python:
```python
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank/batch"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer $KEY", "Content-Type": "text/csv"}
with open('sample.csv','rb') as f:
    r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=f)
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```
Observed: scores appear shifted by 1 when header names contain `candidate` or `id`.

raj_engineer: opened bug PR #1425 to add robust header detection and a strict-mode toggle. Short-term workaround: remove the header row or upload JSONL with explicit per-query candidate arrays. Medium-term: we'll autodetect header and skip it when header-like tokens exist, and also add `?csv_header=true|false` query param for explicit control. ETA for staging patch: ~4 hours.

tom_customer: thanks — removing header fixes it for now. Also worth noting: during our retries we hit a 429 rate limit once — retry bursts might complicate repro.

zoe_pm: adding to docs backlog — need explicit CSV docs and examples. @maya_ml please include edge cases where header-looking content in candidate text could lead to false positives in detection.

maya_ml: noted. Test plan: unit tests for header detection, integration test with CSVs containing both header-like columns and legitimate first-row candidate content. Also add golden-file for CSV->candidate mapping.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/1425 -> staging at 2025-11-02T14:30Z :rocket:

elaine_support: quick follow-up — patched branch on staging appears to skip header appropriately and fixes the shift for the customer's sample. We'll schedule a prod push tomorrow and offer the customer an opt-in to test on staging. Marking this thread resolved for now; reopen if you see recurrence. :white_check_mark:

tom_customer: confirmed staging fix looks good for our sample. appreciate the quick turnaround.

elaine_support: closing ticket pending prod rollout. If anyone sees different variants (CSV with extra columns, quoted headers, BOM, etc.) please append examples here.
